entities.name: B5F8P0 GlpG
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Salmonella agona rhomboid protease GlpG (276 aa).
Annotated as an inner-membrane, multipass rhomboid serine protease that catalyzes intramembrane proteolysis; EC 3.4.21.105.
Reference features place six helical transmembrane regions at residues 94–114, 142–162, 169–189, 192–212, 229–249, and 250–270; active-site annotations at residues 201 and 254.
Sequence-derived estimates: 31.44 kDa and theoretical pI 9.44; Pfam hits Rhomboid_N (1–82) and Rhomboid (133–267).
